name: spinner-status
description: Replaces the tip under the spinner with one short line from Haiku: where this session stands, or a tip about your mods and their commands that fits the moment

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Draw the line under the spinner. Off, the mod does nothing and makes no model call

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: mixed: Haiku writes a session summary and picks a mod tip, and the line alternates between them. tips: mod tips only, in rotation, with no model call. summary: the session summary only

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that writes the line: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id
